params.prompt: Cinematic photoreal shot inside a small family workshop or bakery at closing time. The owner, a middle-aged person seen from behind and slightly from the side, face not visible, sits at a wooden counter looking at a laptop, one hand on the forehead, thoughtful. Warm dark palette, deep coffee-brown shadows, a single warm lamp, subtle yellow accent in the laptop glow. Strong dark vignette, the upper 45% of the frame is nearly black and empty for typography. No readable text on screen, no signs, no logos, no watermark. Square 1:1, calm, moody, realistic.
